issue_request: FHIR-32503 was an Applied/Persuasive Patient Care request to add MedicationRequest support within Procedure.basedOn for cases such as installing a central line under authorization from a MedicationRequest.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit e333c37d3548da36080722466fca490beefd3a42 added a J#32503 committee note and the MedicationRequest targetProfile to source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml. The commit bundled several other Procedure changes, but the FHIR-32503 hunk is present in the current source.
additional_context: Procedure is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, and build.fhir.org/procedure.profile.json exposes CarePlan, ServiceRequest, and MedicationRequest as Procedure.basedOn target profiles. The checked-in source/procedure/procedure.svg still shows only CarePlan and ServiceRequest, but that is a generated-looking diagram artifact; the authoritative XML and generated conformance profile are correct.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Procedure source already implements the requested MedicationRequest reference support, and the only mismatch found was a diagram-only SVG artifact that should not be hand-edited in this workflow.
